items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I think some of the classic examples of his playing is in the Armstrong Band... Those records like Swing That Music... I always listened for it

ctx.x: I think you told me before when I interviewed you without the recorder that Pops Foster influenced your style.

Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Always admired his playing. And I think some of the classic examples of his playing is in the Armstrong Band, which of course I think was actually the Louis Russell Band, but Armstrong fronted the band. Those records like Swing That Music, where his slapping really stands out. And well, some of the fine tunes like this tune Louis composed, If We Never Meet Again. I mean, his bass just influenced me. I always listened for it and did whatever I could to try to sound like Pops Foster.
Were you able to get that from the record, most of it?
